title: Lantern Lake Fishing [left entirely in English]
fish.lantern_eel: Lantern Eel [literally "Eel-Lantern"; "parol" usually means the star-shaped Filipino Christmas lantern]
shop.rods: Fishing Rod [singular; no plural marker, so it reads as one rod rather than a tab of rods]
pass.lucky_bait: With Bait of Luck, your chance of catching rare fish is doubled!
sell.done: You sold the fish (x{count})! Coins: +{coins} ["Coins" left in English]
sell.prompt: Sell using E [reads "using E" rather than "press E"; slightly stiff]
ascend.button: Ascend [English verb "ascend" with the Filipino prefix "mag-"; the English word may be unfamiliar to many players]
ascend.confirm: Ascend now? You'll go back to the start, but you'll catch rare fish {bonus}% more often. [uses the English verb "ascend" with "mag-"]
weather.storm: A storm is coming! Rare fish are biting. ["bagyo" usually means a typhoon, so this can read as a typhoon warning]
quest.title: Quests
quest.catch_n: Catch fish at Moon Bay: {n} ["Look ng Buwan" is literally "Bay of the Moon"; "Look" (bay) can be misread at a glance as the English word "look"]
friends.boost: +{percent}% luck when you fish with your friends
codes.redeemed: Code redeemed! Enjoy your reward. [heavy Taglish: "redeem", "enjoy" and "reward" are English words with Filipino prefixes]
afk.kicked: You were AFK for too long, so your fishing stopped.
event.ends: Ends in {time} [ambiguous: "sa {time}" can mean "in {time}" (countdown) or "at {time}" (clock time)]
daily.streak: Day {day} of your streak! Come back tomorrow for an extra reward.
tip.night: Tip: some fish only bite at night.
group.join: Join our community for 50 free bait!
